name: Proving Grounds: Trial of Hate
summary: A Muramite trial arena engineered to provoke rage, aggression, and emotional volatility through Discord amplification.
description: The Trial of Hate is a brutal arena where Muramite overseers test the ability of combatants to channel or withstand overwhelming aggression. Discord pylons amplify hostility, causing combatants to lash out uncontrollably. Dragorn captives are forced into emotionally charged confrontations, while Muramite soldiers prove their mastery of controlled fury. The arena contains rage chambers, aggression corridors, and Discord hate nodes that intensify emotional instability. Discord anomalies erupt when hatred peaks, creating chaotic and violent conditions.
